Overview

Chennai is a city in Tamil Nadu with a population of 10,970,000. A major cultural and economic center in South India, known for its Marina Beach, classical music scene, and thriving automobile industry. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
